rho_reference.protocol: Named by the protocol (RESEARCH_GLV_INVARIANT_FACTOR_BASES.md section 9.15, registered before any E25 code): on each GLS curve the matched rho is the <±psi> walk, psi the GLS endomorphism (the p^2-power Frobenius twisted back to E, psi^2 = -1), so a class {±P, ±psi P} has 4 points; 16 <±psi>, 16 negation and 16 unfolded walks per curve, all run and all verified. S_B / rho = total F_p multiplications of arm B / mean F_p multiplications of the 16 <±psi> walks (set-up and class representatives included); negation and unfolded walks are recorded alongside (rho_negation_muls, rho_unfolded_muls). Strongest available: on all 10 curves j(E) is in F_{p^2} but not in F_p (checked independently of the repository code), so psi is the only Frobenius-type endomorphism over F_{p^4} and Aut(E) = {±1}: <±psi> is the largest fold. Unpriced native work, read from quartic_folds.rs, klein_v4.rs and gaudry_quartic.rs: both arms charge F_p multiplications only; the index calculus leaves unpriced its Macaulay-matrix entry traffic (emitted as macaulay_entries), the solve's F_p inversions (not emitted; at most one per pivot row, far fewer than the entries) and its F_p additions; the walks leave unpriced each step's hash-table lookup and insert, partition hashes and comparisons (emitted as steps). Band (AGENTS.md section 5a, as the protocol states it): S(g) = F_p multiplications + g * GAE * native operations, one native operation per Macaulay entry or walk step, GAE = the curve's measured F_p multiplications per affine addition (97.0 on every record), g = 0, 0.1, 1; native work is unpriced on both arms, so the three values differ. gae_band holds the medians over the 10 curves of arm B's S_IC(g) and of the <±psi> walk's S_rho(g) (per-curve values: validator-report.json gae_band_rows). Order across the band: the <±psi> walk is below the index calculus on every curve of both arms at all three prices (S_B / rho from 1.13e4-2.65e5 at g = 0 to 7.7e4-2.0e6 at g = 1), so rho is ranked ahead everywhere; arm B is below arm A on every curve at every price (S_A / S_B moves by at most 0.06 % across the band); the improvement (S_A / rho_negation) / (S_B / rho_psi) stays above 1 on every curve at every price (1.10-1.70 at g = 1 for p >= 197, against 1.26-1.97 at g = 0).
rho_reference.unit: F_p multiplications: both arms counted by the same Fp4 type (an F_{p^4} multiplication 19, an inversion 40), the solve's F_p multiplications counted directly, the Wiedemann matrix at 16 per multiplication mod n; walk set-up included
